captions.caption: A man wearing a plaid shirt and tan pants walks into a dense, green forest from the left.
The man approaches a fallen evergreen tree and begins hacking at its branches with a small axe.
He swings the axe with a downward motion to sever the thin branches from the main trunk.
The man continues to clear small, green branches from the middle section of the fallen log.
With each strike of the hand axe, more branches are detached and fall to the forest floor.
He focuses on a dense cluster of branches, using short, forceful swings to clear the bark.
The man pauses momentarily to adjust his grip on the axe before resuming his work.
He moves slightly down the length of the tree, targeting branches further toward the top.
The man strikes a branch multiple times, working to clean the log of any protruding growth.
He continues delimbing the tree, with wood chips and needles scattering around his feet.
The man swings the axe rhythmically, systematically removing every branch in his path.
He clears a larger section of the trunk, exposing more of the underlying wood.
The man shifts his weight as he continues to hack away at the evergreen branches.
He uses the axe to strip away the smaller twigs that are difficult to reach.
The man moves back toward the thicker end of the fallen tree, clearing remaining debris.
He strikes a stubborn branch several times until it finally gives way and falls.
The man continues his steady progress, cleaning the surface of the fallen log.
He clears away a pile of severed branches to maintain a clear workspace around the tree.
The man uses the back of the axe to push some of the fallen debris aside.
He resumes chopping, focusing on a new set of branches on the side of the trunk.
The man swings the axe forcefully to cut through a thicker branch near the base.
He takes a small step over some branches to reach a different angle on the log.
The man continues to remove branches, working his way along the top of the fallen tree.
He uses quick, precise strokes to trim the log, leaving a cleaner surface behind.
The man pauses to look down the length of the tree, planning his next move.
He begins hacking at a large branch that is sticking out horizontally from the trunk.
Several strikes are needed to fully detach the large branch from the fallen tree.
The man continues his delimbing work, moving with purpose through the forest.
He strikes the log again, clearing away a group of smaller, spindly branches.
The man uses the axe to scrape away some of the bark along with the branches.
He focuses on the underside of the trunk, reaching down to chop away low-hanging limbs.
The man continues to clear the area, creating a pile of green brush on the ground.
He swings the axe in a wide arc to remove a particularly long branch.
The man works his way back toward the center of the log, refining his earlier work.
He uses the axe to trim off any remaining stubs from the severed branches.
The man moves to the other side of the log to access branches on the far side.
He strikes the branches with renewed energy, clearing the log efficiently.
The man continues to hack at the tree, his movements steady and practiced.
He uses the axe to clear a path through the dense growth surrounding the fallen tree.
The man strikes a branch near the top of the trunk, sending it falling to the side.
He continues his work, the sound of the axe echoing through the trees.
The man pauses to wipe his brow before continuing to delimb the fallen log.
He targets a cluster of branches near the middle of the tree, hacking them away.
The man uses the axe to chop through a branch that is wedged against another tree.
He continues to clear the area, making the fallen trunk more visible.
The man strikes the log again, removing more of the green foliage.
He moves back toward the base of the tree, clearing the thickest branches.
The man uses forceful swings to break through the tough wood of the larger limbs.
He continues his steady progress, systematically cleaning the entire fallen tree.
The man pauses to adjust his position, stepping over a pile of branches.
He kneels down to reach some branches that are close to the ground.
The man uses the axe to chop away at the low-lying branches with precision.
He continues to work from a crouched position, clearing the underside of the log.
The man strikes the branches repeatedly until they are completely removed.
He stands up and moves back to the middle section of the fallen tree.
The man resumes his standing position, hacking at the remaining branches.
He uses the axe to clear a large branch that was blocking his path.
The man continues to delimb the tree, his focus entirely on the task at hand.
He strikes the log one last time in this section, removing a final branch.
The man moves further down the log, ready to continue cleaning the next section.
